rapport_notes: Personable and thorough, handled scheduling smoothly and kept the customer engaged with a same-call ballpark price.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'so far do you have any concerns, stresser about this move or any questions?' — asked after full logistics discovery and even after a preliminary price was given.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — the agenda question drew only a scope clarification ('once we do the walkthrough we can point out some things'), not a concern to dig into.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'let me know if items are not moving or if you're planning to do the smaller items yourself, all of those factors can definitely help make things quicker on the day.'

top_strength: Correctly identified a large four-bedroom, multi-truck move as walkthrough-appropriate while still giving the customer a same-call ballpark estimate to keep her engaged.
coaching_note: The agenda/concerns line landed only after a full price pitch — asking it up front would catch real concerns before the customer has already mentally committed to a number.
